mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sms_flash_promotion WHERE status = 1 AND start_date <= DATE(#{now}) AND end_date >= DATE(#{now}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM sms_flash_promotion_session WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND status = 1
SELECT * FROM sms_flash_promotion_session WHERE status = 1 AND start_time <= TIME(#{now}) AND end_time >= TIME(#{now}) ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.flash_promotion_id, r.flash_promotion_session_id, r.product_id, p.name AS product_name, r.flash_promotion_price, r.flash_promotion_count, r.flash_promotion_sold_count, r.flash_promotion_limit, r.sort FROM sms_flash_promotion_product_relation r LEFT JOIN pms_product p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE r.flash_promotion_id = #{promotionId} AND r.flash_promotion_session_id = #{sessionId} AND r.flash_promotion_price IS NOT NULL AND r.flash_promotion_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.sort DESC, r.id ASC

SELECT r.id, r.flash_promotion_id, r.flash_promotion_session_id, r.product_id, p.name AS product_name, r.flash_promotion_price, r.flash_promotion_count, r.flash_promotion_sold_count, r.flash_promotion_limit, r.sort FROM sms_flash_promotion_product_relation r LEFT JOIN pms_product p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE r.id = #{relationId}

SELECT r.id, r.flash_promotion_id, r.flash_promotion_session_id, r.product_id, p.name AS product_name, r.flash_promotion_price, r.flash_promotion_count, r.flash_promotion_sold_count, r.flash_promotion_limit, r.sort FROM sms_flash_promotion_product_relation r LEFT JOIN pms_product p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE r.flash_promotion_id = #{promotionId} AND r.flash_promotion_session_id = #{sessionId} AND r.product_id = #{productId} AND r.flash_promotion_price IS NOT NULL AND r.flash_promotion_count IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1
